name: @usepolyglot/monorepo
description: Workspace root for Polyglot. Not published - see packages/cli.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'The workspace root is not publishable. Run: pnpm publish:manual' && exit 1
scripts.publish:manual: pnpm build && d=$(mktemp -d) && pnpm --filter @usepolyglot/cli pack --pack-destination "$d" && npm publish "$d"/usepolyglot-cli-*.tgz --access public
